title: Volute Krater (Mixing Bowl)
department_title: Arts of Greece, Rome, and Byzantium
description: The towering form and ornate handles of this vase are unique to workshops in Southern Italy. A banquet scene with a reclining youth and a woman holding a mirror fills the main field.

title: Marble Head of a Woman
department_title: Arts of Greece, Rome, and Byzantium
description: A portrait of a woman with a centre parting and waved hair drawn back over the ears, in the fashion of the Antonine court.
short_description: Portrait head of a Roman woman.
